data.label: Dead reference
data.description: A reference to a path that does not exist.
data.remedy: Point it at the current path, or remove it

data.label: Ambiguous reference
data.description: One name cited at more than one path, or resolving to several files.

data.label: Duplicate
data.description: Identical or near-identical content in more than one place.
data.remedy: Keep one source; reference it from the others

data.label: Conflict
data.description: Two directives on one subject at opposing levels within overlapping facets.
data.remedy: Operator decides; the loser is superseded

data.label: Stale
data.description: Older than the paths it describes.
data.remedy: Review against the current code; refresh or retire

data.label: Orphan
data.description: Not reachable from any hub and not matched by any scoped facet: no harness loads it.
data.remedy: Link it from a hub, scope it, or retire it

data.label: Noncompliant
data.description: Breaks its kind's contract: missing or invalid frontmatter, over a harness size limit.
data.remedy: Fix the frontmatter or split the document

data.label: Mixed form
data.description: Combines Diátaxis forms (e.g. reference with status records).

data.label: Untracked substrate
data.description: An agent-facing document git does not track (ignored or untracked): it has no history, so drift leaves no trail.
data.remedy: Track it, or make it a rendered output of tracked substrates

data.label: Unreadable
data.description: A document the scan could not parse (encoding, frontmatter syntax).
data.remedy: Fix the encoding or the frontmatter
